54	
55	    # ============================================================== 注册：资产
56	    def register_asset(
57	        self,
58	        asset_id: str,
59	        name: str,
60	        kind: str,
61	        refs: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
62	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
63	        """注册目录资产。
64	
65	        ``refs`` 为 ``[{"schema": 名, "version": 版本, "path": 字段指针}, ...]``，
66	        表示资产对字段的直接引用；路径可写文档指针（``/properties/a``）或
67	        逻辑字段路径（``/a``），注册时统一规整。
68	        """
69	        asset = self._registry.register_asset(asset_id, name, kind, refs or [])
70	        self._index_asset(asset.id, asset.name, asset.kind, list(asset.refs))
71	        return self._asset_view(asset)
72	
73	    def get_asset(self, asset_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
74	        return self._asset_view(self._registry.get_asset(asset_id))
75	
76	    @staticmethod
77	    def _asset_view(asset) -> dict[str, Any]:
78	        return {
79	            "asset_id": asset.id,
80	            "name": asset.name,
81	            "kind": asset.kind,
82	            "refs": [
83	                {"schema": r.schema, "version": r.version, "path": r.path}
84	                for r in asset.refs
85	            ],
86	        }
87	
88	    # ================================================================ 影响分析
89	    def analyze_impact(self, name: str, version: str, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
90	        """字段级影响分析：返回直接引用资产与经其他 Schema 传递引用的资产。"""
91	        return analyze_field(self._registry, name, version, path)
92	
93	    # ============================================================ 影响链路解释
94	    def explain_impact(
95	        self,
96	        name: str,
97	        version: str,
98	        path: str,
99	        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
100	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
101	        """按资产解释指定 Schema 版本中逻辑字段的影响链路（只读）。
102	
103	        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
104	        空列表不选任何资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。所查 Schema、
105	        版本不存在或字段不可达时同样抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。
106	
107	        返回 ``schema``、``version``、``path`` 与按 ``asset_id`` 升序的
108	        ``assets``；每个资产含 ``impact_kind``（``direct`` / ``transitive``
109	        / ``both``）与 ``chains``。直接命中是零步链（``source == target ==
110	        所查字段``）；传递命中给出沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 的实际步进链，同一
111	        ``(source, target)`` 只保留一条最短链（等长取步进定位元组稳定最小
112	        者）。超过既有链深度、引用边或资产上限时抛
113	        :class:`ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。
114	
115	        本调用只读现有注册内容：不注册资源、不生成报告、不写入检索索引；
116	        返回值为独立副本，相同输入得到相同结果。
117	        """
118	        return explain_field(self._registry, name, version, path, asset_ids)
119	
120	    # ============================================================ 批量影响分析
121	    def analyze_impact_batch(self, request: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
122	        """按字段集合筛选受影响资产（只读）。
123	
124	        ``request`` 为字典：``schema``、``version``、``paths``（逻辑字段
125	        路径列表，按首次出现顺序去重）、``mode``（``all`` 要求命中每个
126	        字段，``any`` 要求至少命中一个字段）与可选 ``asset_ids``（去重后
127	        限定候选范围；缺省覆盖全部资产，空列表不选任何资产）。
128	
129	        返回 ``schema``、``version``、``paths``、``mode``、``summary``
130	        （候选资产数、入选资产数、各字段命中资产数、最终命中资产数）与按
131	        ``asset_id`` 升序的 ``assets``；每个资产含 ``matched_fields``
132	        （按输入顺序的实际命中字段）、逐字段明细 ``fields``（命中方式
133	        ``direct`` / ``transitive`` / ``both``，以及与单字段分析同口径的
134	        直接信息与传递引用证据）和资产级 ``impact_kind``。
135	
136	        请求结构不合法抛 :class:`meta_catalog.errors.ImpactAnalysisInvalid`；
137	        Schema、版本、字段或资产不存在抛 :class:`NotFoundError`；链深、
138	        引用边、单字段影响资产数或入选资产总数超过既有公开限制抛
139	        :class:`meta_catalog.errors.ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。
140	
141	        本调用只读现有注册内容：不注册资源、不生成报告、不写入检索索引；
142	        相同输入返回相同结构，返回值不与注册内容共享可变引用。
143	        """
144	        return impact_batch_mod.analyze_impact_batch(self._registry, request)
145	
146	    # ============================================================ 引用完整性审计
147	    def check_schema_references(
148	        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
149	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
150	        """审计已注册 Schema 版本中的跨 Schema ``$ref`` 完整性（只读）。
151	
152	        无参数审计全部版本；只给 ``name`` 按注册顺序审计该名称的各版本；
153	        只给 ``version`` 审计同版本号的全部 Schema；同时给出时审计指定版本，
154	        无匹配版本抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围。
155	
156	        返回普通 dict（可直接 JSON 序列化），含 ``checked``、``total``、
157	        ``resolved``、``issues``、``references``；审计不改动注册内容、
158	        不写入检索索引，相同输入返回相同结果。
159	        """
160	        return copy.deepcopy(audit_mod.check_references(self._registry, name, version))
161	
162	    # ======================================================== 字段级变更识别
163	    def compare_schemas(
164	        self,
165	        name: str,
166	        baseline_version: str,
167	        candidate: Any = None,
168	        *,
169	        candidate_version: str | None = None,
170	        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
171	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
172	        """比较基线版本与候选文档，生成并入库可检索的字段级变更报告。
173	
174	        ``candidate`` 直接给出候选 JSON Schema 文档；或省略它、仅传
175	        ``candidate_version`` 以引用同 Schema 标识下已注册的候选版本。
176	        ``renames`` 为 ``[{"from": 旧路径, "to": 新路径}, ...]``。
177	
178	        任何不合法情形统一抛 :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
179	        相同输入返回相同报告（幂等，不会重复入库）。
180	        """
181	        # 1) 解析候选文档与基线版本。
182	        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
183	            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
184	        )
185	
186	        # 2) 生成报告（重命名校验在其中完成）。
187	        report = compare_mod.build_report(
188	            self._registry,
189	            name,
190	            baseline_version,
191	            candidate_document,
192	            label,
193	            renames,
194	        )
195	
196	        # 3) 幂等入库并进入全文检索范围。
197	        report_id = report["report_id"]
198	        if report_id not in self._reports:
199	            self._reports[report_id] = report
200	        if report_id not in self._indexed_reports:
201	            for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
202	                self._index_change(report, change, i)
203	            self._indexed_reports.add(report_id)
204	        return copy.deepcopy(report)
205	
206	    def _resolve_comparison_inputs(
207	        self,
208	        name: str,
209	        baseline_version: str,
210	        candidate: Any,
211	        candidate_version: str | None,
212	    ) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
213	        """解析并校验比较输入：候选文档（深拷贝）与候选版本标签、基线版本存在性。
214	
215	        校验口径与 :meth:`compare_schemas` 完全一致，失败时抛
216	        :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
217	        """
218	        if candidate is None:
219	            if candidate_version is None:
220	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
221	                    "必须提供候选文档 candidate 或已注册的 candidate_version",
222	                    details={"reason": "candidate_missing"},
223	                )
224	            try:
225	                candidate_record = self._registry.get_schema(name, candidate_version)
226	            except NotFoundError as exc:
227	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
228	                    f"指定版本 {name}@{candidate_version} 不存在",
229	                    details={"reason": "version_not_found", **exc.details},
230	                ) from exc
231	            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate_record.document)
232	            label = candidate_version
233	        else:
234	            validate_schema(candidate)
235	            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
236	            label = candidate_version  # 允许调用方给候选文档附带版本标签
237	
238	        if not self._registry.has_schema(name, baseline_version):
239	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
240	                f"指定版本 {name}@{baseline_version} 不存在",
241	                details={"reason": "version_not_found", "schema": name, "version": baseline_version},
242	            )
243	        return candidate_document, label
244	
245	    # ============================================================ 升级影响汇总
246	    def analyze_upgrade_impact(
247	        self,
248	        name: str,
249	        baseline_version: str,
250	        candidate: Any = None,
251	        *,
252	        candidate_version: str | None = None,
253	        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
254	        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
255	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
256	        """汇总一次升级对目录资产的影响（按资产维度的字段级变更视图）。
257	
258	        候选文档、候选版本、重命名映射与字段路径语义与
259	        :meth:`compare_schemas` 一致；``report_id`` 与相同输入的
260	        ``compare_schemas`` 相同。
261	
262	        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
263	        只覆盖所列资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。
264	
265	        本调用为只读操作：不注册候选文档、不生成/改动变更报告、不写入检索
266	        索引；既有的读取、比较、影响分析与检索行为保持不变。
267	        """
268	        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
269	            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
270	        )
271	        summary = upgrade_mod.build_upgrade_report(
272	            self._registry,
273	            name,
274	            baseline_version,
275	            candidate_document,
276	            label,
277	            renames,
278	            asset_ids,
279	        )
280	        return copy.deepcopy(summary)
281	
282	    # ============================================================== 变更预检
283	    def preview_changes(
284	        self, changes: Any, *, search: dict[str, Any] | None = None
285	    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
286	        """只读预检一批 Schema 变更：不注册、不生成报告、不写索引。
287	
288	        ``changes`` 为 JSON 列表，每项含 ``schema``、``version``、
289	        ``changeType`` 及对应内容；``changeType`` 仅限 ``add_field``、
290	        ``remove_field``、``change_type``、``compatibility_check``、
291	        ``unregister_schema``。``search`` 沿用 :meth:`search` 的检索条件，
292	        用于限定 ``searchPreview`` 的覆盖范围。
293	
294	        返回 ``accepted``、``conflicts``、``impactedItems``、
295	        ``searchPreview``；详见 :mod:`meta_catalog.preview`。
296	        """
297	        return preview_mod.preview_changes(self._registry, self._index, changes, search)
298	
299	    def get_report(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
300	        if report_id not in self._reports:
301	            raise NotFoundError(
302	                f"变更报告 {report_id} 不存在", details={"report_id": report_id}
303	            )
304	        return copy.deepcopy(self._reports[report_id])
305	
306	    def list_reports(
307	        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
308	    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
309	        """列出报告摘要（可按 Schema 名称与版本过滤，版本匹配基线或候选）。"""
310	        out = []
311	        for rid in sorted(self._reports):
312	            r = self._reports[rid]
313	            if name is not None and r["schema"] != name:
314	                continue
315	            if version is not None and version not in (
316	                r["baseline_version"],
317	                r["candidate_version"],
318	            ):
319	                continue
320	            out.append(
321	                {
322	                    "report_id": r["report_id"],
323	                    "schema": r["schema"],
324	                    "baseline_version": r["baseline_version"],
325	                    "candidate_version": r["candidate_version"],
326	                    "summary": r["summary"],
327	                }
328	            )
329	        return out
330	
331	    # ================================================================== 检索
332	    def search(self, keyword: str | None = None, **filters: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
333	        """组合检索 Schema / 资产 / 字段变更。
334	
335	        可选过滤：``schema``、``version``、``field_path``、``change_kind``、
336	        ``compatibility``、``asset_name``、``doc_type``、``limit``。
337	        返回命中条目（含命中字段与命中资产摘要），排序稳定，与插入顺序无关。
338	        """
339	        return self._index.search(keyword, **filters)
340	
341	    def search_page(self, keyword: str | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
342	        """分页检索 Schema / 资产 / 字段变更（只读，不写索引）。
343	
344	        检索条件与排序口径和 :meth:`search` 完全一致：``keyword`` 与
345	        ``doc_type``、``schema``、``version``、``field_path``、
346	        ``change_kind``、``compatibility``、``asset_name``；另接受
347	        ``page_size``（默认 50，仅 1 到 200 的普通整数）与可选 ``cursor``。
348	        第一页不传 ``cursor``，后续页只传上一页返回的 ``next_cursor``。
349	
350	        返回 ``items``（与 ``search`` 同条件结果逐项同构且顺序一致）、
351	        ``total``（调用时索引命中总数）、``page_size``、``next_cursor``
352	        （不透明，末页为 None）。游标绑定全部查询条件与 ``page_size``，
353	        任何一项变化都不得复用。参数或游标不合法时抛
354	        :class:`meta_catalog.errors.SearchQueryInvalid`。
355	        """
356	        return self._index.search_page(keyword, **kwargs)
357	
358	    # ------------------------------------------------------------ 索引维护
359	    def _index_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any, title: str | None) -> None:
360	        fields = sf.expand(document)
361	        root = fields.get("")
362	        description = ""
363	        if root is not None:
364	            d = root.schema.get("description")
365	            description = d if isinstance(d, str) else ""
366	        text_fields = {
367	            "name": name,
368	            "version": version,
369	            "title": title or "",
370	            "description": description,
371	            "field_paths": "\n".join(sorted(fields)),
372	        }
373	        payload = {
374	            "name": name,
375	            "version": version,
376	            "title": title,
377	            "summary": {
378	                "name": name,
379	                "version": version,
380	                "title": title,
381	                "field_count": len(fields),
382	            },
383	        }
384	        self._index.add_doc(
385	            "schema", ("schema", name, version), text_fields, payload
386	        )
387	
388	    def _index_asset(self, asset_id: str, name: str, kind: str, refs: list[FieldRef]) -> None:
389	        schemas = sorted({r.schema for r in refs})
390	        versions = sorted({f"{r.schema}@{r.version}" for r in refs})
391	        text_fields = {
392	            "id": asset_id,
393	            "name": name,
394	            "kind": kind,
395	            "refs": "\n".join(f"{r.schema}@{r.version}{r.path}" for r in refs),
396	        }
397	        payload = {
398	            "id": asset_id,
399	            "name": name,
400	            "kind": kind,
401	            "schemas": schemas,
402	            "versions": versions,
403	            "summary": {
404	                "asset_id": asset_id,
405	                "name": name,
406	                "kind": kind,
407	                "ref_count": len(refs),
408	            },
409	        }
410	        self._index.add_doc("asset", ("asset", asset_id), text_fields, payload)
411	
412	    def _index_change(self, report: dict[str, Any], change: dict[str, Any], seq: int) -> None:
413	        key, text_fields, payload = indexing.change_doc(report, change, seq)
414	        self._index.add_doc("change", key, text_fields, payload)
415

"""公开门面：:class:`MetaCatalog`。

组合注册簿、Schema 校验、字段级比较、影响分析与全文检索。所有成功结果都以
普通 dict/list 返回（可直接 JSON 序列化）；注册、比较、读取与检索均不会改动
既有 Schema 的注册内容、版本关系与资产依赖关系。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
from typing import Any

from . import audit as audit_mod
from . import compare as compare_mod
from . import impact_batch as impact_batch_mod
from . import indexing
from . import preview as preview_mod
from . import schema_fields as sf
from . import upgrade as upgrade_mod
from .errors import NotFoundError, SchemaComparisonInvalid
from .explain import explain_field
from .impact import analyze_field
from .registry import FieldRef, Registry
from .search import SearchIndex
from .validator import validate_schema


class MetaCatalog:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._registry = Registry()
        self._index = SearchIndex()
        self._reports: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self._indexed_reports: set[str] = set()

    # ============================================================ 注册：Schema
    def register_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """注册一个不可变的 Schema 版本。文档不合法时抛 SchemaComparisonInvalid。"""
        validate_schema(document)
        record = self._registry.register_schema(name, version, document)
        self._index_schema(record.name, record.version, record.document, record.title)
        return self.get_schema(name, version)

    def get_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        record = self._registry.get_schema(name, version)
        return {
            "name": record.name,
            "version": record.version,
            "title": record.title,
            "document": copy.deepcopy(record.document),
        }

    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
        return self._registry.list_versions(name)

    # ============================================================== 注册：资产
    def register_asset(
        self,
        asset_id: str,
        name: str,
        kind: str,
        refs: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """注册目录资产。

        ``refs`` 为 ``[{"schema": 名, "version": 版本, "path": 字段指针}, ...]``，
        表示资产对字段的直接引用；路径可写文档指针（``/properties/a``）或
        逻辑字段路径（``/a``），注册时统一规整。
        """
        asset = self._registry.register_asset(asset_id, name, kind, refs or [])
        self._index_asset(asset.id, asset.name, asset.kind, list(asset.refs))
        return self._asset_view(asset)

    def get_asset(self, asset_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._asset_view(self._registry.get_asset(asset_id))

    @staticmethod
    def _asset_view(asset) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "asset_id": asset.id,
            "name": asset.name,
            "kind": asset.kind,
            "refs": [
                {"schema": r.schema, "version": r.version, "path": r.path}
                for r in asset.refs
            ],
        }

    # ================================================================ 影响分析
    def analyze_impact(self, name: str, version: str, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """字段级影响分析：返回直接引用资产与经其他 Schema 传递引用的资产。"""
        return analyze_field(self._registry, name, version, path)

    # ============================================================ 影响链路解释
    def explain_impact(
        self,
        name: str,
        version: str,
        path: str,
        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """按资产解释指定 Schema 版本中逻辑字段的影响链路（只读）。

        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
        空列表不选任何资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。所查 Schema、
        版本不存在或字段不可达时同样抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。

        返回 ``schema``、``version``、``path`` 与按 ``asset_id`` 升序的
        ``assets``；每个资产含 ``impact_kind``（``direct`` / ``transitive``
        / ``both``）与 ``chains``。直接命中是零步链（``source == target ==
        所查字段``）；传递命中给出沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 的实际步进链，同一
        ``(source, target)`` 只保留一条最短链（等长取步进定位元组稳定最小
        者）。超过既有链深度、引用边或资产上限时抛
        :class:`ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。

        本调用只读现有注册内容：不注册资源、不生成报告、不写入检索索引；
        返回值为独立副本，相同输入得到相同结果。
        """
        return explain_field(self._registry, name, version, path, asset_ids)

    # ============================================================ 批量影响分析
    def analyze_impact_batch(self, request: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """按字段集合筛选受影响资产（只读）。

        ``request`` 为字典：``schema``、``version``、``paths``（逻辑字段
        路径列表，按首次出现顺序去重）、``mode``（``all`` 要求命中每个
        字段，``any`` 要求至少命中一个字段）与可选 ``asset_ids``（去重后
        限定候选范围；缺省覆盖全部资产，空列表不选任何资产）。

        返回 ``schema``、``version``、``paths``、``mode``、``summary``
        （候选资产数、入选资产数、各字段命中资产数、最终命中资产数）与按
        ``asset_id`` 升序的 ``assets``；每个资产含 ``matched_fields``
        （按输入顺序的实际命中字段）、逐字段明细 ``fields``（命中方式
        ``direct`` / ``transitive`` / ``both``，以及与单字段分析同口径的
        直接信息与传递引用证据）和资产级 ``impact_kind``。

        请求结构不合法抛 :class:`meta_catalog.errors.ImpactAnalysisInvalid`；
        Schema、版本、字段或资产不存在抛 :class:`NotFoundError`；链深、
        引用边、单字段影响资产数或入选资产总数超过既有公开限制抛
        :class:`meta_catalog.errors.ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。

        本调用只读现有注册内容：不注册资源、不生成报告、不写入检索索引；
        相同输入返回相同结构，返回值不与注册内容共享可变引用。
        """
        return impact_batch_mod.analyze_impact_batch(self._registry, request)

    # ============================================================ 引用完整性审计
    def check_schema_references(
        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """审计已注册 Schema 版本中的跨 Schema ``$ref`` 完整性（只读）。

        无参数审计全部版本；只给 ``name`` 按注册顺序审计该名称的各版本；
        只给 ``version`` 审计同版本号的全部 Schema；同时给出时审计指定版本，
        无匹配版本抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围。

        返回普通 dict（可直接 JSON 序列化），含 ``checked``、``total``、
        ``resolved``、``issues``、``references``；审计不改动注册内容、
        不写入检索索引，相同输入返回相同结果。
        """
        return copy.deepcopy(audit_mod.check_references(self._registry, name, version))

    # ======================================================== 字段级变更识别
    def compare_schemas(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any = None,
        *,
        candidate_version: str | None = None,
        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """比较基线版本与候选文档，生成并入库可检索的字段级变更报告。

        ``candidate`` 直接给出候选 JSON Schema 文档；或省略它、仅传
        ``candidate_version`` 以引用同 Schema 标识下已注册的候选版本。
        ``renames`` 为 ``[{"from": 旧路径, "to": 新路径}, ...]``。

        任何不合法情形统一抛 :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
        相同输入返回相同报告（幂等，不会重复入库）。
        """
        # 1) 解析候选文档与基线版本。
        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
        )

        # 2) 生成报告（重命名校验在其中完成）。
        report = compare_mod.build_report(
            self._registry,
            name,
            baseline_version,
            candidate_document,
            label,
            renames,
        )

        # 3) 幂等入库并进入全文检索范围。
        report_id = report["report_id"]
        if report_id not in self._reports:
            self._reports[report_id] = report
        if report_id not in self._indexed_reports:
            for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
                self._index_change(report, change, i)
            self._indexed_reports.add(report_id)
        return copy.deepcopy(report)

    def _resolve_comparison_inputs(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any,
        candidate_version: str | None,
    ) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
        """解析并校验比较输入：候选文档（深拷贝）与候选版本标签、基线版本存在性。

        校验口径与 :meth:`compare_schemas` 完全一致，失败时抛
        :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
        """
        if candidate is None:
            if candidate_version is None:
                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                    "必须提供候选文档 candidate 或已注册的 candidate_version",
                    details={"reason": "candidate_missing"},
                )
            try:
                candidate_record = self._registry.get_schema(name, candidate_version)
            except NotFoundError as exc:
                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                    f"指定版本 {name}@{candidate_version} 不存在",
                    details={"reason": "version_not_found", **exc.details},
                ) from exc
            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate_record.document)
            label = candidate_version
        else:
            validate_schema(candidate)
            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
            label = candidate_version  # 允许调用方给候选文档附带版本标签

        if not self._registry.has_schema(name, baseline_version):
            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                f"指定版本 {name}@{baseline_version} 不存在",
                details={"reason": "version_not_found", "schema": name, "version": baseline_version},
            )
        return candidate_document, label

    # ============================================================ 升级影响汇总
    def analyze_upgrade_impact(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any = None,
        *,
        candidate_version: str | None = None,
        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """汇总一次升级对目录资产的影响（按资产维度的字段级变更视图）。

        候选文档、候选版本、重命名映射与字段路径语义与
        :meth:`compare_schemas` 一致；``report_id`` 与相同输入的
        ``compare_schemas`` 相同。

        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
        只覆盖所列资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。

        本调用为只读操作：不注册候选文档、不生成/改动变更报告、不写入检索
        索引；既有的读取、比较、影响分析与检索行为保持不变。
        """
        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
        )
        summary = upgrade_mod.build_upgrade_report(
            self._registry,
            name,
            baseline_version,
            candidate_document,
            label,
            renames,
            asset_ids,
        )
        return copy.deepcopy(summary)

    # ============================================================== 变更预检
    def preview_changes(
        self, changes: Any, *, search: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """只读预检一批 Schema 变更：不注册、不生成报告、不写索引。

        ``changes`` 为 JSON 列表，每项含 ``schema``、``version``、
        ``changeType`` 及对应内容；``changeType`` 仅限 ``add_field``、
        ``remove_field``、``change_type``、``compatibility_check``、
        ``unregister_schema``。``search`` 沿用 :meth:`search` 的检索条件，
        用于限定 ``searchPreview`` 的覆盖范围。

        返回 ``accepted``、``conflicts``、``impactedItems``、
        ``searchPreview``；详见 :mod:`meta_catalog.preview`。
        """
        return preview_mod.preview_changes(self._registry, self._index, changes, search)

    def get_report(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if report_id not in self._reports:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"变更报告 {report_id} 不存在", details={"report_id": report_id}
            )
        return copy.deepcopy(self._reports[report_id])

    def list_reports(
        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """列出报告摘要（可按 Schema 名称与版本过滤，版本匹配基线或候选）。"""
        out = []
        for rid in sorted(self._reports):
            r = self._reports[rid]
            if name is not None and r["schema"] != name:
                continue
            if version is not None and version not in (
                r["baseline_version"],
                r["candidate_version"],
            ):
                continue
            out.append(
                {
                    "report_id": r["report_id"],
                    "schema": r["schema"],
                    "baseline_version": r["baseline_version"],
                    "candidate_version": r["candidate_version"],
                    "summary": r["summary"],
                }
            )
        return out

    # ================================================================== 检索
    def search(self, keyword: str | None = None, **filters: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """组合检索 Schema / 资产 / 字段变更。

        可选过滤：``schema``、``version``、``field_path``、``change_kind``、
        ``compatibility``、``asset_name``、``doc_type``、``limit``。
        返回命中条目（含命中字段与命中资产摘要），排序稳定，与插入顺序无关。
        """
        return self._index.search(keyword, **filters)

    def search_page(self, keyword: str | None = None, **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """分页检索 Schema / 资产 / 字段变更（只读，不写索引）。

        检索条件与排序口径和 :meth:`search` 完全一致：``keyword`` 与
        ``doc_type``、``schema``、``version``、``field_path``、
        ``change_kind``、``compatibility``、``asset_name``；另接受
        ``page_size``（默认 50，仅 1 到 200 的普通整数）与可选 ``cursor``。
        第一页不传 ``cursor``，后续页只传上一页返回的 ``next_cursor``。

        返回 ``items``（与 ``search`` 同条件结果逐项同构且顺序一致）、
        ``total``（调用时索引命中总数）、``page_size``、``next_cursor``
        （不透明，末页为 None）。游标绑定全部查询条件与 ``page_size``，
        任何一项变化都不得复用。参数或游标不合法时抛
        :class:`meta_catalog.errors.SearchQueryInvalid`。
        """
        return self._index.search_page(keyword, **kwargs)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ 索引维护
    def _index_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any, title: str | None) -> None:
        fields = sf.expand(document)
        root = fields.get("")
        description = ""
        if root is not None:
            d = root.schema.get("description")
            description = d if isinstance(d, str) else ""
        text_fields = {
            "name": name,
            "version": version,
            "title": title or "",
            "description": description,
            "field_paths": "\n".join(sorted(fields)),
        }
        payload = {
            "name": name,
            "version": version,
            "title": title,
            "summary": {
                "name": name,
                "version": version,
                "title": title,
                "field_count": len(fields),
            },
        }
        self._index.add_doc(
            "schema", ("schema", name, version), text_fields, payload
        )

    def _index_asset(self, asset_id: str, name: str, kind: str, refs: list[FieldRef]) -> None:
        schemas = sorted({r.schema for r in refs})
        versions = sorted({f"{r.schema}@{r.version}" for r in refs})
        text_fields = {
            "id": asset_id,
            "name": name,
            "kind": kind,
            "refs": "\n".join(f"{r.schema}@{r.version}{r.path}" for r in refs),
        }
        payload = {
            "id": asset_id,
            "name": name,
            "kind": kind,
            "schemas": schemas,
            "versions": versions,
            "summary": {
                "asset_id": asset_id,
                "name": name,
                "kind": kind,
                "ref_count": len(refs),
            },
        }
        self._index.add_doc("asset", ("asset", asset_id), text_fields, payload)

    def _index_change(self, report: dict[str, Any], change: dict[str, Any], seq: int) -> None:
        key, text_fields, payload = indexing.change_doc(report, change, seq)
        self._index.add_doc("change", key, text_fields, payload)

1	"""字段级影响分析。
2	
3	直接影响：资产的字段引用与目标字段 ``(schema, version, path)`` 精确相等。
4	传递影响：从资产引用的具体字段出发，沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边正向解析，
5	若能到达目标字段（精确相等、或祖先/后代包含关系），即构成传递命中。
6	
7	正向解析从资产引用的 *具体* 路径出发，路径长度随跨边跳数只减不增，因此
8	即使 Schema 之间存在根级引用环，状态空间也是有限的。传递结果按稳定标识
9	``(资产, schema, version, 引用路径)`` 去重。
10	"""
11	
12	from __future__ import annotations
13	
14	from dataclasses import dataclass
15	
16	from . import limits, pointer as ptr
17	from .errors import ImpactAnalysisTooLarge
18	from .registry import Registry, RefEdge
19	
20	
21	@dataclass(frozen=True)
22	class Reach:
23	    schema: str
24	    version: str
25	    path: str
26	
27	
28	def _related(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
29	    return a == b or ptr.is_under(a, b) or ptr.is_under(b, a)
30	
31	
32	def _build_outgoing(registry: Registry) -> dict[tuple[str, str], list[RefEdge]]:
33	    outgoing: dict[tuple[str, str], list[RefEdge]] = {}
34	    for edge in registry.all_edges():
35	        outgoing.setdefault((edge.src_schema, edge.src_version), []).append(edge)
36	    for edges in outgoing.values():
37	        edges.sort(
38	            key=lambda e: (e.dst_schema, e.dst_version, e.src_path, e.dst_path)
39	        )
40	    return outgoing
41	
42	
43	def forward_reach(
44	    registry: Registry,
45	    schema: str,
46	    version: str,
47	    path: str,
48	    outgoing: dict[tuple[str, str], list[RefEdge]] | None = None,
49	    cache: dict[tuple[str, str, str], list[Reach]] | None = None,
50	) -> list[Reach]:
51	    """从一个具体字段出发正向解析跨 Schema 引用，返回可到达的全部字段。
52	
53	    每条出边满足：边的源路径与当前路径相等，或是当前路径的祖先
54	    （引用了包含当前字段的子树）；目标侧路径按后缀对齐。
55	    """
56	    if cache is not None:
57	        cached = cache.get((schema, version, path))
58	        if cached is not None:
59	            return cached
60	    if outgoing is None:
61	        outgoing = _build_outgoing(registry)
62	
63	    start = Reach(schema, version, path)
64	    reached: dict[Reach, None] = {start: None}
65	    queue: list[tuple[Reach, int]] = [(start, 0)]
66	    edges_walked = 0
67	
68	    while queue:
69	        state, depth = queue.pop(0)
70	        if depth >= limits.MAX_IMPACT_DEPTH:
71	            raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
72	                "影响链深度超过公开限制",
73	                details={
74	                    "reason": "depth_exceeded",
75	                    "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_DEPTH,
76	                    "schema": state.schema,
77	                    "version": state.version,
78	                    "path": state.path,
79	                },
80	            )
81	        for edge in outgoing.get((state.schema, state.version), ()):
82	            sp, cp = ptr.parse(edge.src_path), ptr.parse(state.path)
83	            if not (len(sp) <= len(cp) and cp[: len(sp)] == sp):
84	                continue
85	            edges_walked += 1
86	            if edges_walked > limits.MAX_IMPACT_VISITED:
87	                raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
88	                    "影响链引用边数量超过公开限制",
89	                    details={"reason": "edges_exceeded", "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_VISITED},
90	                )
91	            suffix = cp[len(sp) :]
92	            mapped = Reach(
93	                edge.dst_schema,
94	                edge.dst_version,
95	                ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(edge.dst_path)) + list(suffix)),
96	            )
97	            if mapped in reached:
98	                continue
99	            reached[mapped] = None
100	            queue.append((mapped, depth + 1))
101	
102	    del reached[start]
103	    result = sorted(reached.keys(), key=lambda r: (r.schema, r.version, r.path))
104	    if cache is not None:
105	        cache[(schema, version, path)] = result
106	    return result
107	
108	
109	def analyze_field(registry: Registry, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> dict:
110	    """返回单个字段的影响资产：直接 + 传递（各自稳定排序、去重）。"""
111	    registry.get_schema(schema, version)
112	
113	    direct: dict[str, dict] = {}
114	    transitive_map: dict[tuple[str, str, str, str], dict] = {}
115	    outgoing = _build_outgoing(registry)
116	    reach_cache: dict[tuple[str, str, str], list[Reach]] = {}
117	
118	    for asset in registry.all_assets():
119	        for ref in asset.refs:
120	            if ref.schema == schema and ref.version == version:
121	                if ref.path == path:
122	                    direct.setdefault(
123	                        asset.id,
124	                        {"asset_id": asset.id, "name": asset.name, "kind": asset.kind},
125	                    )
126	                    continue
127	
128	            # 传递：从资产引用的具体字段正向解析到目标字段。
129	            reachable = forward_reach(
130	                registry, ref.schema, ref.version, ref.path, outgoing, reach_cache
131	            )
132	            matched = [r for r in reachable if r.schema == schema and r.version == version
133	                       and _related(r.path, path)]
134	            if not matched:
135	                continue
136	            key = (asset.id, ref.schema, ref.version, ref.path)
137	            entry = transitive_map.get(key)
138	            if entry is None:
139	                entry = {
140	                    "asset_id": asset.id,
141	                    "name": asset.name,
142	                    "kind": asset.kind,
143	                    "schema": ref.schema,
144	                    "version": ref.version,
145	                    "path": ref.path,
146	                    "matched_paths": [],
147	                }
148	                transitive_map[key] = entry
149	            for r in matched:
150	                if r.path not in entry["matched_paths"]:
151	                    entry["matched_paths"].append(r.path)
152	
153	    transitive = list(transitive_map.values())
154	    for entry in transitive:
155	        entry["matched_paths"].sort(key=lambda p: (ptr.parse(p), p))
156	
157	    if len(direct) + len(transitive) > limits.MAX_IMPACT_ASSETS:
158	        raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
159	            "影响资产数量超过公开限制",
160	            details={"reason": "assets_exceeded", "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_ASSETS},
161	        )
162	
163	    return {
164	        "schema": schema,
165	        "version": version,
166	        "path": path,
167	        "direct_assets": [direct[k] for k in sorted(direct)],
168	        "transitive_assets": sorted(
169	            transitive,
170	            key=lambda a: (a["asset_id"], a["schema"], a["version"], a["path"]),
171	        ),
172	    }

1	"""注册簿：Schema 版本、目录资产与跨 Schema 引用关系。
2	
3	注册内容不可变：任何读取都返回深拷贝，比较、影响分析和检索都无法改动
4	既有注册结果、版本关系与资产依赖关系。
5	
6	跨 Schema 引用约定：``$ref`` 写作 ``"<SchemaName>@<version>#<JSONPointer>"``，
7	例如 ``"Address@1.0#/properties/street"``；``#`` 后为空表示引用文档根。
8	文档内引用沿用标准 ``"#/..."`` 形式。
9	"""
10	
11	from __future__ import annotations
12	
13	import copy
14	import re
15	from dataclasses import dataclass
16	from typing import Any
17	
18	from .errors import AlreadyExistsError, NotFoundError
19	from . import pointer as ptr
20	from .schema_fields import expand as _expand_fields
21	
22	_REF_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>[^@#/\s]+)@(?P<version>[^@#\s]+)#(?P<pointer>.*)$")
23	_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+$")
24	
25	
26	def validate_name(name: str, *, what: str = "名称") -> None:
27	    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not _NAME_RE.match(name):
28	        raise ValueError(f"非法{what}: {name!r}（只允许字母、数字、_、.、-）")
29	
30	
31	@dataclass(frozen=True)
32	class SchemaVersion:
33	    name: str
34	    version: str
35	    document: Any
36	    title: str | None
37	
38	
39	@dataclass(frozen=True)
40	class FieldRef:
41	    """资产对某 Schema 某版本某字段路径的直接引用。"""
42	
43	    schema: str
44	    version: str
45	    path: str  # JSON Pointer，"" 表示根

49	class Asset:
50	    id: str
51	    name: str
52	    kind: str
53	    refs: tuple[FieldRef, ...]
54	
55	
56	@dataclass(frozen=True)
57	class RefEdge:
58	    """一条跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边：src 字段定义引用了 dst 字段节点。"""
59	
60	    src_schema: str
61	    src_version: str
62	    src_path: str
63	    dst_schema: str
64	    dst_version: str

66	
67	
68	def parse_external_ref(ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, str] | None:
69	    """解析跨 Schema 引用；非此外部形式返回 ``None``。"""
70	    m = _REF_RE.match(ref)
71	    if not m:
72	        return None
73	    return m.group("name"), m.group("version"), m.group("pointer")
74	
75	
76	def extract_ref_edges(name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> list[RefEdge]:
77	    """提取文档内全部跨 Schema 引用边（原始文档指针，按出现顺序排序）。
78	
79	    指针在注册时再结合两端文档解析为逻辑字段路径。
80	    """
81	    edges: list[RefEdge] = []
82	
83	    def walk(node: Any, path: str, seen: frozenset[int]) -> None:
84	        if isinstance(node, bool) or not isinstance(node, (dict, list)):
85	            return
86	        if id(node) in seen:
87	            return
88	        seen = seen | {id(node)}
89	        if isinstance(node, dict):
90	            ref = node.get("$ref")
91	            if isinstance(ref, str):
92	                parsed = parse_external_ref(ref)
93	                if parsed is not None:
94	                    dst_name, dst_version, fragment = parsed
95	                    if fragment and not fragment.startswith("/"):
96	                        fragment = "/" + fragment
97	                    edges.append(
98	                        RefEdge(name, version, path, dst_name, dst_version, fragment)
99	                    )
100	            for k in sorted(node.keys()):
101	                walk(node[k], path + "/" + _escape(k) if path else "/" + _escape(k), seen)
102	        else:
103	            for i, v in enumerate(node):
104	                walk(v, f"{path}/{i}" if path else f"/{i}", seen)
105	
106	    walk(document, "", frozenset())
107	    edges.sort(key=lambda e: (e.src_path, e.dst_schema, e.dst_version, e.dst_path))
108	    return edges
109	
110	
111	def _escape(token: str) -> str:
112	    return token.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
113	
114	
115	class Registry:
116	    def __init__(self) -> None:
117	        self._schemas: dict[tuple[str, str], SchemaVersion] = {}
118	        # name -> 按注册顺序保存的版本列表
119	        self._versions: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
120	        self._assets: dict[str, Asset] = {}
121	        self._edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[RefEdge, ...]] = {}
122	
123	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ schema
124	    def register_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> SchemaVersion:
125	        validate_name(name, what="Schema 名称")
126	        validate_name(version, what="版本号")
127	        key = (name, version)
128	        if key in self._schemas:
129	            raise AlreadyExistsError(
130	                f"Schema {name}@{version} 已注册，注册内容不可覆盖",
131	                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
132	            )
133	        # 跨 Schema 引用允许前向（目标稍后注册），因此引用环也可注册；
134	        # 目标缺失或目标字段不存在时，影响传播自然不会产生命中。
135	        raw_edges = extract_ref_edges(name, version, document)
136	        edges: list[RefEdge] = []
137	        for e in raw_edges:
138	            dst_record = self._schemas.get((e.dst_schema, e.dst_version))
139	            dst_raw = e.dst_path if e.dst_path else ""
140	            if dst_record is not None:
141	                dst_logical = ptr.resolve_logical(dst_record.document, dst_raw)
142	                if dst_logical is None or dst_logical not in _expand_fields(dst_record.document):
143	                    # 目标已注册但字段不存在：属于确定的非法引用。
144	                    raise NotFoundError(
145	                        f"跨 Schema 引用 {e.dst_schema}@{e.dst_version}{dst_raw} 的目标字段不存在",
146	                        details={
147	                            "schema": e.dst_schema,
148	                            "version": e.dst_version,
149	                            "path": dst_raw,
150	                        },
151	                    )
152	                final_dst = dst_logical
153	            else:
154	                final_dst = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(dst_raw)
155	            src_logical = ptr.resolve_logical(document, e.src_path)
156	            edges.append(
157	                RefEdge(
158	                    name,
159	                    version,
160	                    src_logical or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(e.src_path),
161	                    e.dst_schema,
162	                    e.dst_version,
163	                    final_dst,
164	                )
165	            )
166	        edges.sort(key=lambda x: (x.src_path, x.dst_schema, x.dst_version, x.dst_path))
167	        title = None
168	        if isinstance(document, dict):
169	            t = document.get("title")
170	            title = t if isinstance(t, str) else None
171	        record = SchemaVersion(name, version, copy.deepcopy(document), title)
172	        self._schemas[key] = record
173	        self._versions.setdefault(name, []).append(version)
174	        self._edges[key] = tuple(edges)
175	        return record
176	
177	    def get_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> SchemaVersion:
178	        key = (name, version)
179	        if key not in self._schemas:
180	            raise NotFoundError(
181	                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
182	                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
183	            )
184	        return self._schemas[key]
185	
186	    def has_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> bool:
187	        return (name, version) in self._schemas
188	
189	    def schema_document(self, name: str, version: str) -> Any:
190	        return copy.deepcopy(self.get_schema(name, version).document)
191	
192	    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
193	        if name not in self._versions:
194	            raise NotFoundError(f"Schema {name} 不存在", details={"schema": name})
195	        return list(self._versions[name])
196	
197	    def edges(self, name: str, version: str) -> tuple[RefEdge, ...]:
198	        return self._edges.get((name, version), ())
199	
200	    def all_edges(self) -> list[RefEdge]:
201	        out: list[RefEdge] = []
202	        for key in sorted(self._edges):
203	            out.extend(self._edges[key])
204	        return out
205	
206	    def all_schemas(self) -> list[SchemaVersion]:
207	        return [self._schemas[k] for k in sorted(self._schemas)]
208	
209	    def registered_pairs(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
210	        """按全局注册顺序返回全部 ``(名称, 版本)``。"""
211	        return list(self._schemas.keys())
212	
213	    def logical_path_exists(self, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> bool:
214	        """判断逻辑字段路径是否可达（含沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 跳转解析）。"""
215	        return self._logical_path_exists(
216	            schema, version, path, frozenset({(schema, version)})
217	        )
218	
219	    def _logical_path_exists(
220	        self, schema: str, version: str, path: str, stack: frozenset[tuple[str, str]]
221	    ) -> bool:
222	        """判断逻辑字段路径是否可达，沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转解析。"""
223	        if (schema, version) not in self._schemas:
224	            return False
225	        document = self._schemas[(schema, version)].document
226	        valid_paths = _expand_fields(document)
227	        if path in valid_paths:
228	            return True
229	
230	        target_segs = ptr.parse(path)
231	        # 选择最长的、能覆盖目标路径前缀的出边。
232	        best = None
233	        for edge in self._edges.get((schema, version), ()):  # type: RefEdge
234	            esegs = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
235	            if len(esegs) <= len(target_segs) and target_segs[: len(esegs)] == esegs:
236	                if best is None or len(esegs) > len(ptr.parse(best.src_path)):
237	                    best = edge
238	        if best is None:
239	            return False
240	        dst_key = (best.dst_schema, best.dst_version)
241	        if dst_key in stack:
242	            return False
243	        suffix = target_segs[len(ptr.parse(best.src_path)) :]
244	        resolved = ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(best.dst_path)) + list(suffix))
245	        return self._logical_path_exists(
246	            best.dst_schema, best.dst_version, resolved, stack | {dst_key}
247	        )
248	
249	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- asset
250	    def register_asset(
251	        self,
252	        asset_id: str,
253	        name: str,
254	        kind: str,
255	        refs: list[FieldRef] | list[dict] | None = None,
256	    ) -> Asset:
257	        validate_name(asset_id, what="资产标识")
258	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
259	            raise ValueError("资产名称必须是非空字符串")
260	        if not isinstance(kind, str) or not kind:
261	            raise ValueError("资产类型必须是非空字符串")
262	        if asset_id in self._assets:
263	            raise AlreadyExistsError(
264	                f"资产 {asset_id} 已注册", details={"asset": asset_id}
265	            )
266	
267	        normalized: list[FieldRef] = []
268	        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
269	        for raw in refs or []:
270	            if isinstance(raw, FieldRef):
271	                r = raw
272	            else:
273	                r = FieldRef(raw["schema"], str(raw["version"]), raw.get("path", ""))
274	            validate_name(r.schema, what="引用 Schema 名称")
275	            record = self.get_schema(r.schema, r.version)
276	            if r.path and not r.path.startswith("/"):
277	                raise ValueError(f"资产引用字段路径必须是 JSON Pointer: {r.path!r}")
278	            candidate_paths = []
279	            contextual = ptr.resolve_logical(record.document, r.path)
280	            if contextual is not None:
281	                candidate_paths.append(contextual)
282	            text_normalized = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(r.path)
283	            for cand in (text_normalized, r.path):
284	                if cand not in candidate_paths:
285	                    candidate_paths.append(cand)
286	
287	            resolved_path = next(
288	                (
289	                    cand
290	                    for cand in candidate_paths
291	                    if self._logical_path_exists(
292	                        r.schema, r.version, cand, frozenset({(r.schema, r.version)})
293	                    )
294	                ),
295	                None,
296	            )
297	            if resolved_path is None:
298	                raise NotFoundError(
299	                    f"资产引用的字段 {r.schema}@{r.version}{text_normalized} 不存在",
300	                    details={
301	                        "schema": r.schema,
302	                        "version": r.version,
303	                        "path": text_normalized,
304	                    },
305	                )
306	            r = FieldRef(r.schema, r.version, resolved_path)
307	            dedup_key = (r.schema, r.version, r.path)
308	            if dedup_key in seen:
309	                continue
310	            seen.add(dedup_key)
311	            normalized.append(r)
312	
313	        normalized.sort(key=lambda r: (r.schema, r.version, r.path))
314	        asset = Asset(asset_id, name, kind, tuple(normalized))
315	        self._assets[asset_id] = asset
316	        return asset
317	
318	    def get_asset(self, asset_id: str) -> Asset:
319	        if asset_id not in self._assets:
320	            raise NotFoundError(f"资产 {asset_id} 不存在", details={"asset": asset_id})
321	        return self._assets[asset_id]
322	
323	    def all_assets(self) -> list[Asset]:
324	        return [self._assets[k] for k in sorted(self._assets)]

"""公开限制常量。

这些限制是公开行为契约的一部分：触发上限时统一抛出
:class:`meta_catalog.errors.ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。
"""

# 单次比较允许展开的字段节点数量上限（分析对象规模）。

# 单次比较报告中允许的变更条目数量上限。
MAX_CHANGES = 10_000

# 单个字段做影响分析时允许遍历的跨 Schema 引用链最大深度。
MAX_IMPACT_DEPTH = 32

# 单个字段做影响分析时允许访问的跨 Schema 引用边数量上限。

MAX_IMPACT_ASSETS = 10_000

1	"""字段路径工具。
2	
3	字段路径采用 JSON Pointer（RFC 6901）表示，例如 ``/properties/name``、
4	``/properties/a~1b``。根对象本身用空串 ``""`` 表示。
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	from typing import Any
10	
11	
12	def escape(token: str) -> str:
13	    """转义单个路径段。"""
14	    return token.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
15	
16	
17	def unescape(token: str) -> str:
18	    """反转义单个路径段。"""
19	    return token.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
20	
21	
22	def parse(path: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
23	    """把 JSON Pointer 解析为路径段元组；根路径返回空元组。"""
24	    if path == "":
25	        return ()
26	    if not path.startswith("/"):
27	        raise ValueError(f"非法 JSON Pointer: {path!r}")
28	    return tuple(unescape(seg) for seg in path[1:].split("/"))
29	
30	
31	def format(segments: tuple[str, ...] | list[str]) -> str:
32	    """把路径段组装为 JSON Pointer。"""
33	    return "".join("/" + escape(str(seg)) for seg in segments)
34	
35	
36	def child(path: str, segment: str) -> str:
37	    """返回某路径下的子路径。"""
38	    return (path + "/" + escape(segment)) if path else "/" + escape(segment)
39	
40	
41	def parent(path: str) -> str | None:
42	    """返回父路径；根路径返回 ``None``。"""
43	    segs = parse(path)
44	    if not segs:
45	        return None
46	    return format(segs[:-1])
47	
48	
49	def is_under(prefix: str, path: str) -> bool:
50	    """``path`` 是否位于 ``prefix`` 子树内（含自身）。"""
51	    p, c = parse(prefix), parse(path)
52	    return len(c) >= len(p) and c[: len(p)] == p
53	
54	
55	def resolve(doc: Any, path: str) -> Any:
56	    """在文档中按 JSON Pointer 取值，缺段/越界/类型不符时抛 KeyError。"""
57	    cur: Any = doc
58	    for seg in parse(path):
59	        if isinstance(cur, dict):
60	            if seg not in cur:
61	                raise KeyError(path)
62	            cur = cur[seg]
63	        elif isinstance(cur, list):
64	            try:
65	                idx = int(seg)
66	            except ValueError as exc:
67	                raise KeyError(path) from exc
68	            if not 0 <= idx < len(cur):
69	                raise KeyError(path)
70	            cur = cur[idx]
71	        else:
72	            raise KeyError(path)
73	    return cur
74	
75	
76	def normalize_field_pointer(path: str) -> str:
77	    """把 Schema 文档指针 *无上下文地* 规整为逻辑字段路径。
78	
79	    注意：纯文本规整无法区分「名为 ``items`` 的属性」与 ``items`` 关键字，
80	    资产/引用路径应优先使用逻辑路径，或用 :func:`resolve_logical` 结合
81	    文档解析。
82	    """
83	    segs = list(parse(path))
84	    out: list[str] = []
85	    for i, seg in enumerate(segs):
86	        if seg in ("properties", "prefixItems"):
87	            continue
88	        if seg == "additionalProperties":
89	            out.append("*")
90	        elif seg == "items":
91	            # 元组形式 items/0 展开为数组下标；单 Schema items 展开为 -。
92	            if i + 1 < len(segs) and segs[i + 1].isdigit():
93	                continue
94	            out.append("-")
95	        else:
96	            out.append(seg)
97	    return format(out)
98	
99	
100	def resolve_logical(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str | None:
101	    """结合文档结构，把文档指针解析为逻辑字段路径；不可解析返回 ``None``。
102	
103	    遍历规则与字段展开一致：``properties`` 段省略（其后必为属性名，即使
104	    名字恰好叫 ``items``）；单 Schema ``items`` 段映射为 ``-``；
105	    ``additionalProperties`` 映射为 ``*``；``$defs``/``definitions`` 保留。
106	    """
107	    segs = parse(raw_path)
108	    node: Any = document
109	    logical: list[str] = []
110	    i = 0
111	    while i < len(segs):
112	        seg = segs[i]
113	        if isinstance(node, dict):
114	            props = node.get("properties")
115	            if seg == "properties" and isinstance(props, dict):
116	                # 容器关键字与其后的属性名在同一步消费，避免属性名与
117	                # Schema 关键字（如名为 items 的属性）混淆。
118	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
119	                    return None
120	                name = segs[i + 1]
121	                if name not in props:
122	                    return None
123	                node = props[name]
124	                logical.append(name)
125	                i += 2
126	                continue
127	            pats = node.get("patternProperties")
128	            if seg == "patternProperties" and isinstance(pats, dict):
129	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
130	                    return None
131	                name = segs[i + 1]
132	                if name not in pats:
133	                    return None
134	                node = pats[name]
135	                logical.append(escape(name))
136	                i += 2
137	                continue
138	            ap = node.get("additionalProperties")
139	            if seg == "additionalProperties" and isinstance(ap, (dict, bool)):
140	                node = ap
141	                logical.append("*")
142	                i += 1
143	                continue
144	            items = node.get("items")
145	            if seg == "items" and isinstance(items, (dict, bool)):
146	                node = items
147	                logical.append("-")
148	                i += 1
149	                continue
150	            pre = node.get("prefixItems")
151	            if seg == "prefixItems" and isinstance(pre, list):
152	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
153	                    return None
154	                try:
155	                    idx = int(segs[i + 1])
156	                except ValueError:
157	                    return None
158	                if not 0 <= idx < len(pre):
159	                    return None
160	                node = pre[idx]
161	                logical.append(str(idx))
162	                i += 2
163	                continue
164	            if seg in ("$defs", "definitions") and isinstance(node.get(seg), dict):
165	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
166	                    return None
167	                name = segs[i + 1]
168	                if name not in node[seg]:
169	                    return None
170	                node = node[seg][name]
171	                logical.extend((seg, name))
172	                i += 2
173	                continue
174	            if seg not in node:
175	                return None
176	            node = node[seg]
177	            logical.append(seg)
178	            i += 1
179	        elif isinstance(node, list):
180	            try:
181	                idx = int(seg)
182	            except ValueError:
183	                return None
184	            if not 0 <= idx < len(node):
185	                return None
186	            node = node[idx]
187	            logical.append(seg)
188	            i += 1
189	        else:
190	            return None
191	    return format(logical)
192

4	class CatalogError(Exception):
5	    """所有目录服务错误的基类。
6	
7	    :ivar code: 稳定的公开错误码字符串。
8	    """

10	    code = "CatalogError"
11	
12	    def __init__(self, message, *, details=None):
13	        super().__init__(message)
14	        self.message = message
15	        self.details = details or {}

17	
18	class NotFoundError(CatalogError):

21	    code = "NotFound"

23	
24	class AlreadyExistsError(CatalogError):
25	    """同名资源已注册（注册内容不可变，不支持覆盖）。"""
26	
27	    code = "AlreadyExists"

30	class SchemaComparisonInvalid(CatalogError):
31	    """字段级比较请求不合法。
32	
33	    覆盖以下情形：候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema、指定版本不存在、
34	    重命名起点或终点不存在、同一路径被重复映射、重命名映射跨版本不一致。
35	    """

37	    code = "SchemaComparisonInvalid"

40	class ImpactAnalysisInvalid(CatalogError):
41	    """批量影响分析请求不合法。
42	
43	    覆盖以下情形：请求不是字典、``paths`` 不是列表或含非字符串、
44	    资产标识列表不是列表或含非字符串 / 空字符串、``mode`` 不是
45	    ``all`` 或 ``any``、路径不是合法逻辑 JSONPointer、去重后的字段
46	    集合为空。

52	class ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(CatalogError):
53	    """分析对象数量或影响链长度/数量超过公开限制。"""
54	
55	    code = "ImpactAnalysisTooLarge"
56

"""错误类型与公开错误码。"""


class CatalogError(Exception):
    """所有目录服务错误的基类。

    :ivar code: 稳定的公开错误码字符串。
    """

    code = "CatalogError"

    def __init__(self, message, *, details=None):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.details = details or {}


class NotFoundError(CatalogError):
    """指定的 Schema、版本、资产或报告不存在。"""

    code = "NotFound"


class AlreadyExistsError(CatalogError):
    """同名资源已注册（注册内容不可变，不支持覆盖）。"""

    code = "AlreadyExists"


class SchemaComparisonInvalid(CatalogError):
    """字段级比较请求不合法。

    覆盖以下情形：候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema、指定版本不存在、
    重命名起点或终点不存在、同一路径被重复映射、重命名映射跨版本不一致。
    """

    code = "SchemaComparisonInvalid"


class ImpactAnalysisInvalid(CatalogError):
    """批量影响分析请求不合法。

    覆盖以下情形：请求不是字典、``paths`` 不是列表或含非字符串、
    资产标识列表不是列表或含非字符串 / 空字符串、``mode`` 不是
    ``all`` 或 ``any``、路径不是合法逻辑 JSONPointer、去重后的字段
    集合为空。
    """

    code = "ImpactAnalysisInvalid"


class ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(CatalogError):
    """分析对象数量或影响链长度/数量超过公开限制。"""

    code = "ImpactAnalysisTooLarge"


class SearchQueryInvalid(CatalogError):
    """分页检索请求不合法。

    覆盖以下情形：``page_size`` 不是 1 到 200 的普通整数、``keyword`` 或
    过滤值不是字符串或 None、出现未公开的关键字参数（如 ``limit``）、
    ``cursor`` 缺失内容、格式非法、来源未知或与当前查询条件 / ``page_size``
    不匹配。
    """

    code = "SearchQueryInvalid"

7	
8	  * ``resolved``        目标版本存在，片段对应的逻辑字段可达；
9	  * ``missing_schema``  目标 Schema 版本未注册（允许前向引用，注册期不报错）；
10	  * ``invalid_pointer`` 目标版本存在，但片段不能解释为字段指针（容器关键字
11	                        后缺字段名、数组下标越界/非数字、穿过非 Schema 取值
12	                        等结构性非法情形）；
13	  * ``missing_field``   片段能解释为逻辑字段路径，但该字段在目标中不可达：
14	                        属性/定义名缺失，或既不在目标字段表中、也无法沿跨
15	                        Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转到达。可达性口径与
16	                        :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 一致，引用环按实际引用
17	                        位点访问一次后终止。
18	
19	字段路径口径同样沿用影响分析：根路径为空串、数组元素为 ``-``、
20	``additionalProperties`` 为 ``*``。相同输入始终给出相同的统计、排序与
21	结论；审计不改动注册内容、不写入检索索引。
22	"""

24	from __future__ import annotations
25	
26	from dataclasses import dataclass
27	from typing import Any

29	from . import pointer as ptr, schema_fields as sf
30	from .errors import NotFoundError
31	from .registry import RefEdge, Registry, parse_external_ref, extract_ref_edges

33	RESOLVED = "resolved"
34	MISSING_SCHEMA = "missing_schema"
35	MISSING_FIELD = "missing_field"
36	INVALID_POINTER = "invalid_pointer"

38	# 结构解释结果：
39	#   ("field", logical_path)   片段完整落在某个字段节点上
40	#   ("missing", logical_path) 片段意图指向某字段，但字段在文档中缺失
41	#   ("edge", logical_path)    停在外部 $ref 节点上，剩余片段需跨边继续
42	#   ("invalid", None)         片段结构性非法，不构成字段指针
43	_FIELD = "field"
44	_MISSING = "missing"
45	_EDGE = "edge"
46	_INVALID = "invalid"

50	class _Edge:
51	    """逻辑化后的跨 Schema 引用边（两端均按当前文档重新解析）。"""

74	def _select_sources(
75	    registry: Registry, name: str | None, version: str | None
76	) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
77	    """按参数语义选出受审的 ``(名称, 版本)``，保持注册顺序；无匹配抛 NotFound。"""
78	    pairs = registry.registered_pairs()
79	    if name is not None and version is not None:
80	        if not registry.has_schema(name, version):
81	            raise NotFoundError(
82	                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
83	                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
84	            )
85	        return [(name, version)]
86	    if name is not None:
87	        # name 不存在时 list_versions 抛 NotFoundError。
88	        return [(name, v) for v in registry.list_versions(name)]
89	    if version is not None:
90	        matched = [(n, v) for n, v in pairs if v == version]
91	        if not matched:
92	            raise NotFoundError(
93	                f"版本 {version} 下没有已注册的 Schema",
94	                details={"version": version},
95	            )
96	        return matched

100	def _logical_path(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str:
101	    """文档指针 -> 逻辑字段路径；无法结构化解析时退回无上下文规整。"""
102	    return ptr.resolve_logical(document, raw_path) or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(
103	        raw_path
104	    )

107	def _build_edges(registry: Registry) -> dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]]:
108	    """从不可变注册文档重新提取并逻辑化全部跨 Schema 引用边。
109	
110	    前向引用在注册期只能按文本规整目标路径；审计时目标通常已注册，这里
111	    结合两端当前文档重新解析，使可达性判定与引用书写顺序无关。
112	    """
113	    out: dict[tuple[str, str], list[_Edge]] = {}
114	    for src_name, src_version in registry.registered_pairs():
115	        document = registry.get_schema(src_name, src_version).document
116	        edges: list[_Edge] = []
117	        raw: RefEdge
118	        for raw in extract_ref_edges(src_name, src_version, document):
119	            if registry.has_schema(raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version):
120	                dst_doc = registry.get_schema(
121	                    raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version
122	                ).document
123	                dst_path = _logical_path(dst_doc, raw.dst_path)
124	            else:
125	                dst_path = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(raw.dst_path)
126	            edges.append(
127	                _Edge(
128	                    src_name,
129	                    src_version,
130	                    _logical_path(document, raw.src_path),
131	                    raw.dst_schema,
132	                    raw.dst_version,
133	                    dst_path,
134	                    raw.dst_path,
135	                )
136	            )
137	        out[(src_name, src_version)] = tuple(edges)
138	    return out
139	
140	
141	def _external_ref(node: Any) -> tuple[str, str, str] | None:
142	    if isinstance(node, dict) and isinstance(node.get("$ref"), str):
143	        return parse_external_ref(node["$ref"])
144	    return None

147	def _interpret(document: Any, fragment: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
148	    """把原始片段结合目标文档结构解释为逻辑字段路径。
149	
150	    规则与 :func:`meta_catalog.pointer.resolve_logical` 的字段展开口径一致，
151	    但对「字段缺失」与「片段结构性非法」加以区分，并在停于外部 ``$ref``
152	    节点时提示调用方沿跨 Schema 边继续解析。
153	    """
154	    try:
155	        segs = ptr.parse(fragment)
156	    except ValueError:
157	        return _INVALID, None
158	
159	    node: Any = document
160	    logical: list[str] = []
161	    i = 0
162	    while i < len(segs):
163	        seg = segs[i]
164	
165	        if isinstance(node, bool) or not isinstance(node, (dict, list)):
166	            # 穿过叶子 Schema/标量继续取段：字段不可达（非结构性非法）。
167	            suffix = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(ptr.format(segs[i:]))
168	            return _MISSING, ptr.format(list(logical) + list(ptr.parse(suffix)))
169	
170	        if isinstance(node, list):
171	            try:
172	                idx = int(seg)
173	            except ValueError:
174	                return _INVALID, None
175	            if not 0 <= idx < len(node):
176	                return _INVALID, None
177	            node = node[idx]
178	            logical.append(seg)
179	            i += 1
180	            continue
181	
182	        # 停在外部 $ref 节点上、仍有后续段：交由边跳转解析。
183	        if _external_ref(node) is not None:
184	            suffix = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(ptr.format(segs[i:]))
185	            return _EDGE, ptr.format(list(logical) + list(ptr.parse(suffix)))
186	
187	        props = node.get("properties")
188	        if seg == "properties":
189	            if i + 1 >= len(segs) or not isinstance(props, dict):
190	                return _INVALID, None
191	            name = segs[i + 1]
192	            if name not in props:
193	                return _MISSING, ptr.format(logical + [name])
194	            node = props[name]
195	            logical.append(name)
196	            i += 2
197	            continue
198	
199	        pats = node.get("patternProperties")
200	        if seg == "patternProperties":
201	            if i + 1 >= len(segs) or not isinstance(pats, dict):
202	                return _INVALID, None
203	            name = segs[i + 1]
204	            if name not in pats:
205	                return _MISSING, ptr.format(logical + [ptr.escape(name)])
206	            node = pats[name]
207	            logical.append(ptr.escape(name))
208	            i += 2
209	            continue
210	
211	        ap = node.get("additionalProperties")
212	        if seg == "additionalProperties":
213	            if isinstance(ap, dict):
214	                node = ap
215	                logical.append("*")
216	                i += 1
217	                continue
218	            return _INVALID, None
219	
220	        items = node.get("items")
221	        if seg == "items":
222	            if isinstance(items, dict):
223	                node = items
224	                logical.append("-")
225	                i += 1
226	                continue
227	            if isinstance(items, list):
228	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
229	                    return _INVALID, None
230	                raw_idx = segs[i + 1]
231	                try:
232	                    idx = int(raw_idx)
233	                except ValueError:
234	                    return _INVALID, None
235	                if not 0 <= idx < len(items):
236	                    return _INVALID, None
237	                node = items[idx]
238	                logical.append(raw_idx)
239	                i += 2
240	                continue
241	            return _INVALID, None
242	
243	        pre = node.get("prefixItems")
244	        if seg == "prefixItems":
245	            if i + 1 >= len(segs) or not isinstance(pre, list):
246	                return _INVALID, None
247	            raw_idx = segs[i + 1]
248	            try:
249	                idx = int(raw_idx)
250	            except ValueError:
251	                return _INVALID, None
252	            if not 0 <= idx < len(pre):
253	                return _INVALID, None
254	            node = pre[idx]
255	            logical.append(raw_idx)
256	            i += 2
257	            continue
258	
259	        if seg in ("$defs", "definitions"):
260	            defs = node.get(seg)
261	            if i + 1 >= len(segs) or not isinstance(defs, dict):
262	                return _INVALID, None
263	            name = segs[i + 1]
264	            if name not in defs:
265	                return _MISSING, ptr.format(logical + [seg, name])
266	            node = defs[name]
267	            logical.extend((seg, name))
268	            i += 2
269	            continue
270	
271	        # 其余段：键存在则继续下沉；落在非 Schema 取值上为非法。
272	        if seg not in node:
273	            # 兼容直接书写逻辑路径（/name）与未知名：先按候选字段处理，
274	            # 最终由字段表/跨边可达性裁决。
275	            return _MISSING, ptr.format(logical + [seg] + list(segs[i + 1 :]))
276	        node = node[seg]
277	        logical.append(seg)
278	        i += 1
279	
280	    # 片段耗尽：落点必须是一个字段 Schema（dict/bool）；标量/容器关键字非法。
281	    if isinstance(node, (dict, bool)):
282	        return _FIELD, ptr.format(logical)
283	    return _INVALID, None
284	
285	
286	def _field_exists(registry: Registry, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> bool:
287	    document = registry.get_schema(schema, version).document
288	    return path in sf.expand(document)
289	
290	
291	def _reachable(
292	    registry: Registry,
293	    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
294	    schema: str,
295	    version: str,
296	    path: str,
297	) -> bool:
298	    """逻辑字段路径是否可达：自身为字段，或沿覆盖当前路径前缀的出边跳转可达。
299	
300	    出边匹配与后缀对齐和 :func:`meta_catalog.impact.forward_reach` 同口径
301	    （全部前缀匹配出边都会尝试，取最长/任一可达即可）。每条解析分支上同一
302	    目标 ``(Schema, 版本)`` 只进入一次，因此引用环按实际引用位点判断一次后
303	    终止；分支数与版本数均有限，遍历必然结束。
304	    """
305	    positive: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
306	
307	    def search(
308	        cur_schema: str,
309	        cur_version: str,
310	        cur_path: str,
311	        visited_versions: frozenset[tuple[str, str]],
312	    ) -> bool:
313	        if (cur_schema, cur_version, cur_path) in positive:
314	            return True
315	        if _field_exists(registry, cur_schema, cur_version, cur_path):
316	            positive.add((cur_schema, cur_version, cur_path))
317	            return True
318	
319	        cur_segs = ptr.parse(cur_path)
320	        for edge in edges.get((cur_schema, cur_version), ()):
321	            edge_segs = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
322	            if not (
323	                len(edge_segs) <= len(cur_segs)
324	                and cur_segs[: len(edge_segs)] == edge_segs
325	            ):
326	                continue
327	            dst_key = (edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version)
328	            if dst_key in visited_versions or not registry.has_schema(*dst_key):
329	                continue
330	            suffix = cur_segs[len(edge_segs) :]
331	            mapped = ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(edge.dst_path)) + list(suffix))
332	            if search(
333	                edge.dst_schema,
334	                edge.dst_version,
335	                mapped,
336	                visited_versions | {dst_key},
337	            ):
338	                return True
339	        return False
340	
341	    if not registry.has_schema(schema, version):
342	        return False
343	    return search(schema, version, path, frozenset({(schema, version)}))
344	
345	
346	def _classify(
347	    registry: Registry,
348	    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
349	    edge: _Edge,
350	) -> str:
351	    """判定单条引用边状态。"""
352	    if not registry.has_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version):
353	        return MISSING_SCHEMA
354	
355	    document = registry.get_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version).document
356	    kind, logical = _interpret(document, edge.fragment)
357	    if kind == _INVALID:
358	        return INVALID_POINTER
359	    # field / missing / edge 三种解释统一交给跨边可达性裁决。
360	    if _reachable(
361	        registry, edges, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, logical or edge.dst_path
362	    ):
363	        return RESOLVED
364	    return MISSING_FIELD
365	
366	
367	def _message(f: _Finding) -> str:
368	    where = f"{f.target_schema}@{f.target_version}{f.target_fragment}"
369	    if f.status == MISSING_SCHEMA:
370	        return f"跨 Schema 引用的目标 {f.target_schema}@{f.target_version} 未注册"
371	    if f.status == INVALID_POINTER:
372	        return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的片段不是目标文档中的合法字段指针"
373	    return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的字段路径 {f.target_path} 在目标版本中不可达"
374	
375	
376	def check_references(
377	    registry: Registry, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
378	) -> dict[str, Any]:
379	    """审计受审 Schema 版本中的全部跨 Schema ``$ref``。"""
380	    sources = _select_sources(registry, name, version)
381	    source_set = set(sources)
382	    edges = _build_edges(registry)
383	
384	    findings: list[_Finding] = []
385	    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = set()
386	    unresolved_sources: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
387	
388	    for src_name, src_version in sources:
389	        for edge in edges.get((src_name, src_version), ()):
390	            status = _classify(registry, edges, edge)
391	            identity = (
392	                src_name,
393	                src_version,
394	                edge.src_path,
395	                edge.dst_schema,
396	                edge.dst_version,
397	                edge.dst_path,
398	            )
399	            if identity in seen:
400	                continue
401	            seen.add(identity)
402	            if status != RESOLVED:
403	                unresolved_sources.add((src_name, src_version))
404	            findings.append(
405	                _Finding(
406	                    src_name,
407	                    src_version,
408	                    edge.src_path,
409	                    edge.dst_schema,
410	                    edge.dst_version,
411	                    edge.dst_path,
412	                    edge.fragment,
413	                    status,
414	                )
415	            )
416	
417	    total = len(sources)
418	    resolved = total - len(unresolved_sources & source_set)
419	
420	    # 逻辑化后按定位六元组稳定排序，去重与书写位置无关。
421	    findings.sort(
422	        key=lambda f: (
423	            f.source_schema,
424	            f.source_version,
425	            tuple(ptr.parse(f.source_path)),
426	            f.source_path,
427	            f.target_schema,
428	            f.target_version,
429	            tuple(ptr.parse(f.target_path)),
430	            f.target_path,
431	        )
432	    )
433	
434	    references = [
435	        {
436	            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
437	            "source_version": f.source_version,
438	            "source_path": f.source_path,
439	            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
440	            "target_version": f.target_version,
441	            "target_path": f.target_path,
442	            "status": f.status,
443	        }
444	        for f in findings
445	    ]
446	
447	    issues = [
448	        {
449	            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
450	            "source_version": f.source_version,
451	            "source_path": f.source_path,
452	            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
453	            "target_version": f.target_version,
454	            "target_path": f.target_path,
455	            "reason": f.status,
456	            "message": _message(f),
457	        }
458	        for f in findings
459	        if f.status != RESOLVED
460	    ]
461	
462	    return {
463	        "checked": total,
464	        "total": total,
465	        "resolved": resolved,
466	        "issues": issues,
467	        "references": references,
468	    }
